Question: is recruiting a Shambling Horde an action that requires
Necromancy?

Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
"Brad" <Bra...@pacbell.net> a écrit dans le message news:
3B40D90A...@pacbell.net...

> Question: is recruiting a Shambling Horde an action that requires
> Necromancy?

Yes. you can deduct it by looking at the small "skull symbol" on the left
side of the card ;)
And, yes, you can pay one less blood if you have Path of bones (and a
giovanni is doing the recruit action)
And, yes again, you can tap London tower to gain one pool if this recruit
action is succesful ;)
(un)life is beautiful, isn't it ?

reyda
